MEDIA: profiled by name in two business/entrepreneur magazines (Brandz Magazine and Success India Magazine, 'Dr. K. Vamshi Krishna's Inspiration to Become a Doctor') - entrepreneur-press coverage is itself a commercial-profile signal. Apparently listed in the Andhra Pradesh Neuro Scientists Association neurosurgeon members roll. VOLUME CLAIM NOT RECORDED: a search summary paraphrased that he 'has performed many thousands of surgeries successfully', but no exact published wording or figure was visible, so per the no-estimates rule no volume is quoted here.
